data.narrative:
Arbe Robotics is a public-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $118M to date. The valuation universe for this company is constrained: while five private peers operate in Drones & Autonomous—including Joby Aviation, Archer Aviation, Zipline, Nuro, and Elroy Air—no public comparables exist in this sector. The private peer set totals seven companies, but the narrow filters required for reliable peer-median analysis (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier) yielded insufficient datapoints for statistical rigor.

The peer-median method was deemed inapplicable due to this cohort limitation. With only two same-stage peers identified and zero adjacent-stage or similar-tier matches, the threshold of three or more comparable datapoints required for meaningful triangulation was not met. Attempting an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable distortion given Drones & Autonomous' distinct capital intensity, timeline to revenue, and technical risk profile relative to broader sectors.

This analysis therefore cannot support a triangulated valuation range at this time. The absence of both public comparables and a sufficiently dense private peer set at Arbe's stage creates material uncertainty. Key dependencies for future valuation work include: (1) establishment of revenue or near-term commercialization metrics; (2) secondary market transactions or IPO pricing data from closer peers; and (3) clarification of Arbe's specific subsegment within Drones & Autonomous to enable more targeted peer selection.
